title.topic:
Moses—A Prepared Person,
Called By God
title.point: God prepared Moses to be the right person to serve God's people. It takes many years of preparation to become useful to God!

lastWeekReview.title: The Children of Israel: Sovereignly Cared For By God
bullets: Jacob's family of 70 grew to TWO MILLION Israelites over 400 years in Egypt!
The new Pharaoh was scared — there were more Israelites than Egyptians!
Pharaoh's Plan #1: Make them slaves! Forced them to build treasure cities with hard labor.
But the MORE they were afflicted, the MORE they multiplied! God was sovereign!
Pharaoh's Plan #2: Kill all baby boys! But God made the Hebrew women so strong their babies were born before the midwives arrived.
No matter what Pharaoh did, God kept His people growing stronger!
lastWeekReview.discussion: 📖  How did God sovereignly care for the Israelites even when things looked impossible?
lastWeekReview.verseQuote: "But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation..." — 1 Peter 2:9a

kidsContent.text: Remember how Pharaoh ordered all Hebrew baby boys to be thrown into the river? One mother had a plan!
Moses' mother made a waterproof basket from papyrus and sealed it with tar. She placed baby Moses in the basket and set it among the reeds by the river.
His big sister Miriam hid nearby to watch over him. When Pharaoh's daughter came to bathe, she found the basket and felt sorry for the crying baby.
Clever Miriam ran up and offered to find a Hebrew woman to nurse the baby — and brought their own mother! Moses grew up safe in his family, learning to love and follow God.
God had a special plan for Moses from the very beginning!

image.caption: Miriam watches over baby Moses in the basket

kidsContent.text: Moses Was Prepared Step by Step!

Step 1 — Palace Education: God arranged for Moses to grow up in Pharaoh's palace — the best school in the world! He learned Egyptian language, math, science, and how to lead. By age 40, Moses had the highest education.
Step 2 — Heart for God: Even in the palace, Moses never forgot God. He chose to be with God's people rather than enjoy the riches of Egypt!
Step 3 — Wilderness Training: After leaving Egypt at age 40, Moses became a humble shepherd for another 40 YEARS. In the desert he learned patience, humility, and compassion.
Three things Moses needed: knowledge of God, the highest education, and excellent character. It took 80 years of preparation!
🌟 To be useful to God requires us to be prepared — and that takes time and patience!

lesson.practicePoint: This week, think about how God is preparing YOU right now — through school, through your family, through challenges. Do your best in everything and be ready to share how God is preparing you!

memoryVerse.text: …He will be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, useful to the master, prepared unto every good work.
memoryVerse.application: Just like God spent 80 years preparing Moses to be the right person, God is preparing each of us too! When we study hard and build our character, we become vessels unto honor — useful to God for every good work.

parts.text: Materials: Large paper strips, markers, tape, timeline template
Each team creates a timeline of Moses' life showing his 3 stages of preparation:
Stage 1 (0-40): Birth, basket, palace education — write 3 key events
Stage 2 (40-80): Wilderness shepherd — write what Moses learned (patience, humility, compassion)
Stage 3 (80+): Burning bush — God calls Moses! Write what happened.
Bonus: Add YOUR own timeline below! What is God teaching you right now at your age?
📖 Connection: It took Moses 80 years to be fully prepared. God is preparing us too!

rolePlayScript.text: Scene: The wilderness near Mount Horeb. Moses is tending sheep.
Moses had been a shepherd in the wilderness for 40 years. One day, he led his flock to the backside of a mountain...
Another quiet day with the sheep. Wait — what is THAT?!
Moses points at a bush that is on fire but not burning up.
That bush is on fire... but it's not burning up! I've never seen anything like this! I must go look!
Moses walks closer to the bush. A voice calls out.
Do not come any closer. Take off your sandals — you are standing on holy ground!
Moses quickly takes off his sandals and bows down.
I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. I have seen how My people suffer in Egypt. I have heard their cries. I am sending YOU to bring them out!
Me?! Who am I to go to Pharaoh?
I will be with you. This is the sign: after you bring My people out of Egypt, you will worship God on THIS mountain.
God had spent 80 years preparing Moses — first in the palace, then in the wilderness. Now Moses was finally ready to serve God's people!
God prepares us to be useful to Him! Let's be vessels unto honor!

description.text: Setup: Three stations representing Moses' 3 life stages. Teams of 3-4.
Station 1 (Palace): Solve a simple math puzzle or word scramble.
Station 2 (Wilderness): Balance a ball on a spoon while walking a course (patience!).
Station 3 (Burning Bush): Take off shoes, run to the finish line, and shout 'Here I am!'
📖 Connection: Moses needed different training at each stage — just like we do!
Materials: Puzzle cards, spoons, small balls, cones
Setup: One player is 'Moses' (the tagger). Everyone else spreads out in the gym.
Rules: When Moses tags someone, they must freeze and stand like a 'burning bush' (arms up, wiggling fingers like flames).
A frozen player can be freed if another player taps them and says 'Here I am!'
Switch Moses every 2-3 minutes. The Moses who freezes the most bushes wins!
📖 Connection: God called Moses at the burning bush — and Moses answered 'Here I am!'

description.text: Hide 10 cards around the outdoor area. Each card describes one event from Moses' life.

Examples: 'Baby in a basket' 'Miriam watched over me' 'Grew up in the palace' 'Learned math and science' 'Chose God's people' 'Became a shepherd' 'Learned patience' 'Saw a burning bush' 'God called my name' 'Sent to free Israel'
Teams must find the cards AND put them in the correct order on Moses' timeline!
First team to find all 10 and arrange them in order wins!
Materials: 10 printed cards with events, numbered answer sheet

outdoor.tip: 🔥 This week's lesson covers Moses' WHOLE life preparation (80 years!). Help kids see that even school and chores are part of God's preparation for them!
